name: Polka Pudding
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: few drops essence of lemon
ingredients.originalText: a few drops essence of lemon

instructions.text: Mix arrowroot in a pint of cold milk
Beat eggs well and add butter (cut into small bits), rose water, essence of lemon or ratafia, sugar
Boil two pints of milk in a double boiler
When boiling stir in the other ingredients, without taking the boiler off the stove
Let it boil till thick, then pour into a mould to cool
Turn it out and serve cold

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix arrowroot in a pint of cold milk
2. Beat eggs well and add butter (cut into small bits), rose water, essence of lemon or ratafia, sugar
3. Boil two pints of milk in a double boiler
4. When boiling stir in the other ingredients, without taking the boiler off the stove
5. Let it boil till thick, then pour into a mould to cool
6. Turn it out and serve cold
originalIngredients: a few drops essence of lemon
